# Draft:The Battle of the 2nd Floor

----
The Battle of the 2nd Floor (17 January 2023 - 17 January 2023 ) was a majorly significant hallway confrontation fought between the Clan of the Rocks and the Clan of the Loyalists on the eastern wing of the second floor of the school. Though lasting only minutes, the clash is considered one of the most intense territorial disputes of the academic year and has since been referenced in accounts of inter-clan relations.
Background
In the months leading up to the encounter, tensions between student factions remained largely dormant. The Clan of the Rocks, known for its tight internal unity and habit of roaming through shared spaces, operated with little regard for territorial customs. Opposing them was the Clan of the Loyalists, a disciplined and orderly group of also sharing ties to the student council who held the eastern front locker row as their primary stronghold.
While no prior hostilities had been recorded, both clans maintained strong identities and occasionally competed for influence within the school’s corridors.
Causes of the Conflict
The immediate cause of the confrontation was an unintended incursion by a Rocks' member into a Loyalist-controlled locker. Contemporary reports indicate that the intrusion was on purpose and the Rocks were not aware that this was a Loyalist locker. However, the Loyalists interpreted the act as a direct violation of their territorial sovereignty.
Within minutes, Loyalist sentries alerted nearby members, who surrounded the Rocks' members along the eastern hallway.
Opposing Forces
Clan of the Rocks
Strength: 2-3 members present
Characteristics: Informal chain of command; adaptable and loosely coordinated; known for confidence in confrontations.
Clan of the Loyalists
Strength: 5-7 members present.
Characteristics: Structured hierarchy; emphasis on order and discipline; regarded their locker territory as inviolable, some members part of student council.
The Engagement
The engagement on 17 January 2023 is believed to have lasted between five and ten minutes. Upon sighting the Rocks’ break in on the Loyalist locker, Loyalist members formed a circular line formation determined to surround the few Rocks' members, blocking access and demanding accountability for the earlier breach.
The Rocks, taken by surprise yet unwilling to concede ground, attempted to advance out the engulfing formation. Heated exchanges followed, with both sides issuing accusations and counterclaims regarding territorial rights, intent, and honor. Despite the absence of physical blows, witnesses described the intensity of the confrontation as “battle-like,” marked by aggressive posturing, raised voices, and refusal to retreat.
A brief escalation occurred when a Loyalist frontliner declared to be the class vice president and threatening a suspension for the Rocks' members, prompting a halt in the Rocks counterattacks. Neutral students reported the atmosphere as “tense enough to spark open conflict,” though neither faction crossed into physical engagement.
The battle concluded abruptly when the Rocks, recognizing the growing attention from bystanders, disengaged and withdrew from the corridor.
Aftermath
No disciplinary action followed the battle, as no staff members directly observed the confrontation. Both sides claimed symbolic victory:
The Loyalists for successfully defending what they regarded as sovereign territory.
The Rocks for refusing to yield or acknowledge wrongdoing.
This altercation would prompt the Clan of the Rocks to never step foot onto the 2nd floor again out of choice. The Clan of the Rocks would happily return to the 2nd floor by the time the Clan of Loyalists disbanded a few months after the battle.
Legacy
Despite its short duration and lack of casualties, the Battle of the 2nd Floor is remembered as a defining micro-conflict of its academic year. The incident is often cited in retrospectives as a case study in:
- territorial culture within student groups.
In later retellings, the battle has been exaggerated as a full-scale standoff, solidifying its role in the informal history of the school. The Clan of the Rocks still refer to the battle from time to time as a defining factor in their academic years.
